of.needed: which metrics are currently being scraped or used in dashboards/alerts in the environment

consequence.statement: Monitoring scrape configurations, dashboards, and alerts that reference the removed metrics querier_cache_added_total, querier_cache_gets_total, and querier_cache_misses_total will no longer receive data from those metrics after upgrade to 3.0.0.
consequence.remediation: Update monitoring configurations, dashboards, and alert rules to use the replacement metrics: loki_cache_fetched_keys, loki_cache_hits, and loki_cache_request_duration_seconds, which provide equivalent instrumentation for the configured cache layer (embeddedcache, memcached, or redis).

assertion.statement: Three Loki querier cache metrics (querier_cache_added_total, querier_cache_gets_total, querier_cache_misses_total) are removed in 3.0.0 and replaced by three new metrics (loki_cache_fetched_keys, loki_cache_hits, loki_cache_request_duration_seconds) that instrument requests to the configured cache backend.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: metrics are operational outputs rather than configuration subjects; no family in the schema covers removed metrics
